name: Held at Death’s Door (Prayer)
body:
The gods of death prevent your demise, this time.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Death Domain

Benefit: Once per day, when a blow strikes you that would otherwise kill you, the god of death allows you to retain a single hit point short of dying. You are stable and do not need to roll for stabilization. You are still unconscious and are not immune to additional attacks that may kill you.
